name: KAP Industrial Holdings Limited
summary: KAP Industrial Holdings Limited engages in the contractual logistics, passenger transport, timber, chemical, automotive components, and bedding businesses in South Africa, rest of Africa, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, Australasia, the Americas. It operates through Diversified Industrial, Diversified chemical, and Diversified Logistics segments. The Diversified Industrial segment manufactures and sells forestry and timber products, such as sawlogs, poles, pulpwood, structural timber, particleboard and medium-density fiberboard products, foils, worktops, melamine face boards, gloss boards, formaldehyde and UF resin, and impregnated paper; and bedding products comprising mattresses and base sets, foam and related products, mattress ticking, and non-woven spunbond products. This segment also offers automotive components, including textile-based automotive acoustic and soft trim components; underfloor systems for thermal and impact protection and aluminum heatshields; overlay carpets/loose-lay vehicle mats and tonneau covers; polyurethane flexible foam, molded seats, conventional and pour-in-place headrests, foam pads, side bolsters, and armrests; polyester and polyether flexible, semi-rigid, and rigid thermoformable foams; acoustically engineered tufted automotive carpets; and automotive accessories made from mild and stainless steel. The Diversified Chemical segment manufactures polyethylene terephthalate, high-density polyethylene, and polypropylene. The Diversified Logistics segment designs, implements, and manages supply chain, warehousing, and logistics services to the petroleum, chemical, food, agriculture, mining, cement, and general freight and warehousing sectors; and provides personnel, tourist, intercity, and commuter transport services. The company is headquartered in Stellenbosch, South Africa.
